# Jobs at Speak\_

Join a community of diverse software engineers in a free, 4-week, online program to get prepared for your interview at top tech companies.We at Speak\_ offer a free pre-interview prep service for software engineers with CS or equivalent degrees. We partner with top 10 tech employers to provide this free training and provide insights into their interview process and tests, ensuring higher interview passing ratios for candidates. This service is 100% free to candidates (the companies pay us). We have placed hundreds of computer science professionals at top companies for free! Our mission is to bring access to opportunities for underrepresented candidates at no charge to you.Join our community of 30,000+ diverse software engineers in a free, online program to sharpen skills and get prepared for interviews at top tech companies we partner with.We currently have opportunities with Checkr, Labelbox, Amazon, and LTSE.
